description: BenchKeeper keeps your AI coding agents' workbench in order: Claude Code or Codex runs its skills to install and check rules, skills and tools at pinned versions, machine-wide and per repository. A full agentic SDLC fits features and risky changes, not every change, so the rules size each request first and small changes skip the steps they do not need.

prerequisites.name: GitHub CLI
prerequisites.for: issues and pull requests (optional, local branches without it)

parallelTools.name: Orca
points: one git worktree per agent; the same prompt across several agents to compare results
terminal splits, SSH remote worktrees, mobile companion app
`/global-setup` offers its `orca-cli` and `orchestration` skills, only after asking
parallelTools.when: you want terminal-centered parallel agents with worktrees, remote machines or mobile access

parallelTools.name: Nimbalyst
points: parallel sessions on a kanban board, one-click worktree per session
every agent edit arrives as a diff you approve or reject
visual editors (Markdown, CSV, mockups, diagrams), task tracking, iOS app
parallelTools.when: you want to review each change visually and work on docs, mockups and tasks next to the agents

parallelTools.name: cmux
points: notifications when an agent needs input; sidebar with branch, PR status and ports
parallelTools.when: you are on macOS and want a terminal-first workflow without a separate app layer

openhands.name: OpenHands
openhands.summary: A different role from the three above: a self-hosted agent server with a web UI that runs work without you at the terminal.
points: Each conversation can run in its own Docker container (`OH_CONVERSATION_RUNTIME=docker`), one of the isolation options BenchKeeper does not provide.
Runs its own agent or hosts Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI; works with any LLM.
Automations on a schedule or on webhook events (GitHub, Slack, Linear), for example splitting GitHub issues into tasks.
Without a sandbox, the local agent has full access to your filesystem.
Unverified: whether agents inside its containers load the BenchKeeper rules and skills; they are installed on the host, not in those containers.

sdlc.requirements: Requests come from you, GitHub issues, Jira, Linear or other trackers, bug reports, reviews and Maintain findings, linked or pasted; only GitHub issues are automated.

steps.name: Understand
steps.tip: Reads the request, AGENTS.md and the code it touches. No edits yet.
steps.text: Read the request, `AGENTS.md` and the code the change touches before any edit.

steps.name: Track
steps.tip: Standard and full tiers: turns the request into a GitHub issue with goal, acceptance criteria and tasks. You approve it.
steps.text: Standard and full tiers, no GitHub issue yet: the agent turns the request into title, goal, acceptance criteria and tasks, and creates the issue after your approval.

steps.name: Branch
steps.text: `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`, or `<type>/<slug>` without an issue; never work on the default branch without being told to.

steps.name: Specify
steps.tip: Full tier: writes the spec as an OpenSpec change, or uses plan mode.
steps.text: Full tier: `spec-driven-development`, written as an OpenSpec change when the repository has one.

steps.name: Plan
steps.tip: Full tier: breaks the spec into small tasks with acceptance criteria.
steps.text: Full tier: `planning-and-task-breakdown` into small tasks with acceptance criteria.

steps.name: Build
steps.tip: Implements task by task, tests first, the smallest complete change.
steps.text: `incremental-implementation`, tests first where a test suite exists, Ponytail `full` for the smallest complete change.

steps.name: Verify
steps.tip: Runs build, types, lint and tests in the devcontainer; checks UI changes in a browser.
steps.text: Build, types, lint and tests inside the devcontainer; UI changes in a browser through Playwright MCP.

steps.name: Review
steps.tip: Standard and full tiers, and risky quick changes: reviews the commits for correctness before push. Findings wait for you.
steps.text: Standard and full tiers, and risky quick changes: correctness review of the commits before `git push`; findings stop the push until you decide.

steps.name: Ship
steps.tip: Opens a draft pull request, waits for checks, marks it ready. You merge.
steps.text: Draft pull request, with `Closes #n` when an issue exists; wait for checks, mark ready. Merge only on your instruction.

steps.name: Maintain
steps.tip: On request (/maintain); the agent suggests it after a milestone or a large merge: audit, debt, dependencies, docs drift, unused skills. Findings become new requests.
steps.text: On request (`/maintain`); the agent suggests it after a milestone or a large merge: `ponytail-audit`, `ponytail-debt`, dependency audit, docs drift, `/doctor prompt-audit`, `/skill-doctor`, repository hygiene. Findings become new requests.
